observation.visible_scene: Night-time cityscape viewed across a calm river. On the left is a large illuminated arena/convention-center building; on the right a lit Ferris wheel (blue/purple rim, yellow spokes) and distant purple-lit structures. A green-lit grass embankment with streetlights runs along the far bank, and the same lights plus the wheel are mirrored in the water in the foreground. Smoke from prior explosions hangs in the sky above the embankment.
visible_changes: Vertical rocket trails rise in three columns over the smoke throughout the early frames (t=0–0.7s).
Around t=0.8s a bright white-yellow burst ignites high in the center, then decays into a small star pattern by t=1.0s.

From about t=1.0s onward two to three golden-orange starburst fireworks bloom and expand in the upper-middle sky, their sparks spreading outward and beginning to fall; a left-side burst joins the central ones.
The expanding bursts and their falling sparks become mirrored as orange streaks in the river surface from roughly t=1.1s to the end, growing brighter as the sky blooms peak.
The Ferris wheel's yellow spokes shift orientation slowly across the clip, indicating a slow rotation; its blue rim lights remain on.
Lingering smoke drifts and is faintly illuminated by the bursts; the building, embankment lights and streetlights stay essentially static.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the fireworks display began before t=0 or continues after t=2.67s (both ends are crop boundaries).
The launch mechanism, ground positions of the fireworks, and any observers are not visible.
The full rotation cycle of the Ferris wheel is not shown.
uncertain_details: Exact speed and direction of the Ferris wheel rotation (only a small spoke-angle change is visible).
Whether any slight camera framing drift exists; background landmarks appear fixed, so the camera is likely stationary.
Precise number of distinct burst shells versus trails, as overlapping smoke obscures some launches.
